SELECT

  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as total_gross_sales,
  SUM(fsl.standard_cost) as total_cost,

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  SUM(COALESCE(fsl.net_amount, 0)) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as net_sales,
  CASE 
    WHEN (SUM(COALESCE(fsl.gross_amount, 0)) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_gross), 0)) > 0 
    THEN ROUND(
      ((SUM(COALESCE(fsl.gross_amount, 0)) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_gross), 0)) - 
       (SUM(COALESCE(fsl.standard_cost, 0)) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0))) / 
      (SUM(COALESCE(fsl.gross_amount, 0)) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_gross), 0)) * 100, 
      2)
    ELSE NULL
  END as gross_margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
FULL OUTER JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON COALESCE(fsl.product_key, frl.product_key) = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND (fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26' OR frl.return_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26')
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

Electrical | 186455.95 | 53.45
Garden | 149762.79 | 51.56
(2 rows)

WITH sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_net,
    SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as sales_gross,
    SUM(fsl.standard_cost) as sales_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
returns_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as returns_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_gross), 0) as returns_gross,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0) as returns_cost
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND frl.return_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.category, r.category) as category,
  COALESCE(s.sales_net, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) as net_sales,
  ROUND(
    ((COALESCE(s.sales_gross, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_gross, 0)) - 
     (COALESCE(s.sales_cost, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_cost, 0))) / 
    (COALESCE(s.sales_gross, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_gross, 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) as gross_margin_pct
FROM sales_by_category s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_category r ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY category

Garden | 148547.46 | 51.6

-- Check for any staff purchases or null values that might affect the calculation
SELECT 
  dp.category,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) as staff_purchase_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_net_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_cost
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26'
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

-- Recalculate excluding staff purchases (standard practice for commercial reporting)
WITH sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_net,
    SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as sales_gross,
    SUM(fsl.standard_cost) as sales_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26'
    AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
returns_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as returns_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_gross), 0) as returns_gross,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0) as returns_cost
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND frl.return_date BETWEEN '2025-09-22' AND '2025-10-26'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.category, r.category) as category,
  COALESCE(s.sales_net, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) as net_sales,
  ROUND(
    ((COALESCE(s.sales_gross, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_gross, 0)) - 
     (COALESCE(s.sales_cost, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_cost, 0))) / 
    (COALESCE(s.sales_gross, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_gross, 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) as gross_margin_pct
FROM sales_by_category s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_category r ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY category
